_provenance: Programme-supplied PILOT readiness criteria written for this synthetic demo by the product-lead and requirements-engineer; not taken from any standard or regulator. A real firm replaces them with criteria agreed by its compliance function.

PILOT.name: Limited broker pilot readiness (synthetic cases, then consenting pilot firms)

criteria.text: Regulatory triage complete and every candidate area reviewed and signed off by the compliance officer or legal counsel, incl. the perimeter question
Requirements lint clean (no errors) and traced to stakeholder needs
Every requirement has a planned verification activity and every need a validation activity
Lender criteria validate with no errors and no stale rules
AI eval gates pass on the pinned live model configuration
Independent validation of the AI component completed
Human oversight matrix validated: broker decides, lender staff make credit decisions, override and challenge routes exist
Threat model reviewed and tenant-isolation mitigations implemented and tested
DPIA signed by the Data Protection Officer
Lender credit staff confirm the encoded criteria for each pilot lender
